WITH date_hits AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
sales_hits AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, 'store' AS channel
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_hits ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_hits.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, 'web'
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_hits ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_hits.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk, 'catalog'
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_hits ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_hits.d_date_sk
),
address_hits AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM address_hits AS ah
JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ah.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sales_hits AS sh
    WHERE sh.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND sh.channel = 'store'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sales_hits AS sh
    WHERE sh.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND sh.channel IN ('web','catalog')
)
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
